items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever know Pill, Crippled Pill, played clarinet? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He lived out here in town.

ctx.x: No, he don't play them no more because, uh, some of the fellas, they don't know him, you know? Uh-huh. A lot of times people come to the unexpected and action for those numbers and, well, he knew it and I probably knew it and Howard might know it and what the balance of the other fellas don't know it. So we just let him go.
Did you ever know Pill, Crippled Pill, played clarinet?
Yeah. He lived out here in town.
